description: The store assigns the id; callers never predict it (ADR-0023).

sections.situation: Night transit restrictions are announced from 1 October; Q4 cargoes are booked.
sections.conditions: Restrictions are evidenced by one origin only; nothing on the board refutes them.
sections.facts:
One evidenced report, repeated by two media (one origin). Insurance quotes rose
fast last time.
sections.action: Reroute the next three laden tankers via the Cape of Good Hope.
sections.alternatives: Hold course with war-risk cover; delay sailings by two weeks.
sections.exclusions: No night transits while restrictions apply.
sections.rationale: My reroute rule fires; the cost of delay outweighs the extra distance.
